metadata.description: The Log10x plugin, which installs the log10x-mcp server pinned to one release.

plugins.name: log10x
plugins.description: Lower your Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, CloudWatch or ClickHouse log bill and keep every line. The 10x engine runs beside the log forwarder you already have and compacts, tiers down or offloads logs pattern by pattern; this plugin gives Claude the controls: what each pattern costs and where it goes. Log data never reaches log10x.
